source: ACS 2020-2024 5-year total population by block group (B01003), placed with Census 2020 block counts (P1, TIGER/Line tabblock20)
method: Each block group's ACS population is split across its 2020 blocks in proportion to their 2020 counts and spread evenly over each block's land (block minus TIGER 2024 area water); summed over the animation image's pixels at each step. Outlines are each block's land (block minus area water), simplified by 4 m; land area is the Census ALAND20 (at least 0.001 km2).
